IgnoreAnimWhitelist.blurb: When true, allows playing animations that are normally blocked while on the charger (animator testing).

EyeDartFocusValue_pix.blurb: Focus / amplitude scale (pixels) for keep-alive eye dart motion driven by the animation component.

ShouldPreCacheSprites.blurb: If true, pre-cache animation sprite assets when loading canned anims (memory vs hitch tradeoff).

PlayAnimationByName.blurb: Console function: play a named animation. Args: animName, optional numLoops, optional renderInEyeHue.

AddAnimation.blurb: Console function: load/add an animation file by path (see function tooltip for signature).
